integrity: All theorem statements are supported by the clique-by-clique symbolic majority inequalities and by a separate finite labelled-state simulator. No independent review is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Finite, connected, loopless bridge barbell with each clique size at least three; only the synchronous open-neighbour binary majority rule with lazy ties is treated.
Closed binomial formulas cover exact terminal-delay populations in all parity cases, but not every intermediate basin stratum.
Computational checks are finite and only corroborate the exact symbolic proof.
Historical novelty is a bounded comparison to accessible primary texts and published records, not a guarantee against unindexed prior specializations.
title: Sharp parity-dependent stabilization and critical-bridge counts for majority dynamics on barbell graphs
